architectReview.evidence: Delegated architect review (agent 3-ReviewLlmParity, opus) returned APPROVE with all three lanes CLEAR and no blocking findings. It verified all four acceptance criteria: (1) reuses the existing LlmClient + ExecCtx/Executor seam with no parallel path and no new deps; (2) the no-key deterministic path is behaviorally identical — ExecCtx.llm was already Option and stays None when LlmClient::from_env finds no key, so every executor takes its exact prior branch (confirmed by e2e case A/D); (3) failure analysis is strictly additive — `failed` increments only on !outcome.passed and the exit code is failed==0?0:1; analyze_failure errors resolve to None and never rescue a failed test (e2e case B: test still FAIL, 1/2 passed); (4) generate() bails clearly without a key and skips non-object plan items. It raised three P3/negligible nits; two were fixed this pass (run.rs now logs tracing::warn! when analysis errors instead of silently discarding; generate.rs now resolves the OpenAI key BEFORE parsing --from so a bad file with no key surfaces the key bail — verified). The remaining micro-nit (llm cloned into ctx + a double !outcome.passed eval) is negligible and accepted. Reverified green after the fixes.

executorQa.evidence: Real end-to-end with a LIVE OpenAI key. artifacts/llm-parity-e2e.txt: (A) deterministic no-key path (HOME override + unset OPENAI_API_KEY) runs spec cases unchanged — PASS/FAIL, exit 1, NO analysis lines; (D) --json emits a valid JSON array of {id,title,passed,error}; (B) with the real key, the failing spec case produced a genuine LLM classification `[bug] The endpoint '/nope' does not exist, leading to a 404 ... — fix: Implement the '/nope' endpoint` while the test still counted as FAIL (1/2 passed, exit 1); (C0) `test generate` with no key errors cleanly. artifacts/llm-generate-e2e.txt: real `test generate --instruction` produced 6 structured cases (happy + edge: no-todos, missing/empty/too-long title) stored as spec-less backend cases. Post-fix: `test generate --from bad.json` with no key now bails on the key first. build clean, clippy 0, cargo test 11/11 (adds add_value test).
